title: [bundle] Apply and audit fleet deployment remediation: run hf fleet s
objective: Apply and audit fleet deployment remediation: run hf fleet sync for the current meta fleet, fix/remediate remaining ledger guard, WAL/SHM guard, JSONL export, legacy SQLite ledger, and tracked ledger violations where safely automatable; produce before/after fleet status evidence and clear next gaps for any residual manual/multi-repo work.
acceptance_criteria: Before/after fleet status evidence is captured for actual hf fleet sync remediation, including counts for ledger_guard_missing, walshm_guard_missing, jsonl_export_missing, legacy_sqlite_ledger, tracked_ledger, and onboarding_missing.

Any fleet member writes produced by hf fleet sync are inspected, scoped to permitted handoff deployment artifacts/guards, and either committed through the owning repo flow or explicitly reverted with a recorded residual gap.
Residual non-automatable fleet deployment gaps are enumerated with member names and next remediation commands instead of hidden behind a green dry-run.
Drift audit passes for the handoff task scope after checkpoint/handoff/export.
test_commands: hf fleet status --json | jq -e '([.members[] | select(.ledger_guard_missing or .walshm_guard_missing or .jsonl_export_missing or .legacy_sqlite_ledger or .tracked_ledger or .onboarding_missing)] | length) == 0'
hf fleet sync --dry-run --json | jq -e '.remediated == 0 and .all_resolved == true'
